conviction_note: Seven small findings net to +0.9: a crowded and growing short (127-143M shares, DTC 5.6-5.8, put/call OI 0.27), a stock already 68% off its high, four straight up-reactions to prints and a likely Blade-driven revenue beat, set against unconfirmed 2026 operating targets (Dubai/first passengers, two deliveries) with eight weeks left, Q3 ATM dilution and a probable verdict accrual. abs_move is held near the 9.0% implied move because the guide-timing question is binary. p_up is only 54 because the +7.4 put skew points the other way and every positive here is positioning or proxy rather than an unseen company number.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$0.25 and revenue $38.2M (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/JOBY/earnings-forecasts) / $40.0M (Chartmill, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/JOBY/estimates); Tickflow -$0.23 / $40M. Company guide: FY2026 revenue $115-125M (H1 = $24.2M + $38.6M = $62.8M, so H2 implied $52-62M) and H2 cash use $385-415M (https://ir.jobyaviation.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/187/joby-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). The stock does not trade on revenue. It trades on the 2026 operating targets: first passengers, Dubai launch and two aircraft deliveries.
positioning_check: Short interest 143.2M shares, 21.3% of float, up 12.5% from the prior period, days to cover 5.8 (stocktitan, as of 2026-11-04, https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/JOBY/). Curvedtrading/chartexchange show 127.28M shares and 5.6 days for the 2026-09-30 settlement, up from 109.8M and 2.43 days on 2026-07-15 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/joby/short-interest/). Equibles gives 10.94% of float on 2026-08-20. Percent of float varies with the float definition, but the short is crowded and rising. Options: 25d skew +7.39 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.27 (call-heavy), event-implied move 9.02%, ATM spread 18% of mid. Spot $5.175 is +7% today on the Air Force release, 12% above the 52-week low and 68% below the high, with a 20-day run-up of -10%.

findings.finding: Joby's three 2026 operating targets are unconfirmed as of 2026-11-04 with eight weeks left: first passengers in 2026, a Dubai launch before year-end, and two additional aircraft deliveries. Every press release since the Q2 letter (eIPP Texas 9/10, cross-country 9/18, Florida 10/30, Air Force 11/4) is silent on Dubai, GCAA aircraft approval and passengers. The Q3 letter has to reaffirm these targets or slip them to 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 print (first-passenger and Dubai target reaffirmed, revenue beat) gained +21.2%. The Q2 print (targets reaffirmed, guide raised) gained +5.5%. The 2025-08 print fell -8.9%. No release in the baseline slipped these targets outright.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. A 68% drawdown and Barclays' $4 target (Oct 9) already discount execution risk, and a Fool piece on Oct 30 named Dubai as the catalyst with slip risk. If a 2027 slip were fully priced, the stock would not have rallied 7% today, and options would not be call-heavy (P/C OI 0.27) into the print.
findings.independence: Dubai launch 'before end of 2026' still depends on GCAA aircraft approval (Fool 2026-10-30, https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/30/joby-aviations-dubai-launch-is-the-1-catalyst-that/). The vertiport was GCAA-certified in July 2026 (https://www.agbi.com/aviation/2026/07/dubais-first-vertiport-is-given-operational-clearance/). Barclays' capacity doubt is in https://www.tikr.com/blog/joby-aviation-stock-has-lost-61-this-year-heres-why-barclays-doubts-its-factory-can-keep-up. This finding is an absence plus a calendar; no document says a slip is coming.

findings.finding: Joby put a $750M at-the-market program in place on 2026-08-11 (424B5 filed 2026-08-14). The Q3 10-Q will disclose how much was sold at $5-8. Stocktitan shows 993.9M shares outstanding, against about 930M implied by a $4.82B market cap at $5.19. The money funds Resonant Sciences (about $450-500M, mostly cash, closing early 2027) and H2 burn of $385-415M, against $2.3B of cash at 6/30. That is a defence build-out and runway, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock slipped on dilution fears after the ATM was filed (StocksToTrade, 2026-08-18). After the Q3 2025 print, which came with a $500M+ offering, the stock fell -4.5% (baseline 2025-11-05).
findings.why_not_priced: The facility is known, but the amount sold is not; it surfaces in the 10-Q. A large Q3 sale near the lows would read as dilution at the bottom. Had the market priced heavy usage, short interest would not still be rising into the print.
findings.independence: The Davis Polk deal note confirms the $750M size (https://www.davispolk.com/experience/joby-aviation-750-million-market-offering). The Resonant Sciences cash use is in the Aug 11 release (https://ir.jobyaviation.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/189/joby-aviation-to-scale-defense-business-through-acquisition).

findings.finding: A federal jury awarded Aerosonic $116.9M against Joby in a trade-secrets case on 2026-10-02/06; Joby is challenging it. If Q3 accrues it as a recognised subsequent event, GAAP loss per share widens by about $0.12 against the -$0.25 consensus and the headline reads as a miss. Joby is appealing and may argue the loss is not probable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The verdict itself cost about 8% to a new 52-week low on 2026-10-09. No prior print carried a litigation accrual.
findings.why_not_priced: The verdict is priced, since the stock already fell on it. What is not visible is whether consensus EPS includes an accrual. The two aggregators both sit at -$0.25, unchanged by a $0.12 charge, which suggests it does not. The item is non-cash and below the operating line, with no path to guidance, so it is sized as a fraction of its dollars.
findings.independence: The tikr piece of 2026-10-13 says Joby asked the court to overturn the verdict (https://www.tikr.com/blog/joby-aviation-stock-has-lost-61-this-year-heres-why-barclays-doubts-its-factory-can-keep-up). This finding shares the GAAP-EPS line with the remeasurement finding, which offsets it.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 GAAP results carried a $108M non-cash charge for the fair value of warrants and earn-out shares, because the stock rose in Q2. The stock then fell roughly 19.8% in July and was near $6.45 by 9/20. Any instrument still marked to market at 9/30 therefore gives Q3 a non-cash gain that flatters GAAP EPS against -$0.25.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's $108M charge produced a GAAP EPS miss of $0.02 (MarketBeat 2026-08-05), and the stock still gained +5.5%. The market looked through the line.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregator consensus EPS rarely models mark-to-market lines. If the gain were in the estimates, they would have risen as the stock fell; Chartmill shows Q3 EPS estimates revised DOWN over three months. The remaining liability is uncertain: NYSE filed a Form 25 on 2026-08-11, possibly the public warrants delisting at the 5-year expiry.
findings.independence: July -19.8%: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/10/why-joby-aviation-stock-plummeted-198-in-july-but/. Down 54% YTD by 9/20: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/20/joby-aviation-stock-is-down-54-this-year-heres-why/. This finding shares the trefis document with the verdict finding, and the two roughly offset.

findings.finding: Joby issued 2,419,801 earn-out shares on 2026-09-10 because Blade's acquired passenger operations hit their 12-month EBITDA milestones. Q3 is Blade's seasonal peak (summer routes), Blade already beat Q2 revenue by 27% ($38.6M vs about $30.2M), and Q3 revenue consensus is $38-40M. That makes a revenue beat more likely than not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 beat on revenue: +21.2%. Q2 2026 beat revenue by 27% but missed EPS by $0.02: +5.5%. The name has paid for revenue beats, but revenue is not the line it trades on.
findings.why_not_priced: The earn-out 8-K is a resale-prospectus item that no preview cites. Revenue estimates were revised up 9.6% in three months (Chartmill), so part of this is in the bar. A fully priced beat would mean consensus above the $40M top of Q2-plus-seasonality, and it is not.
findings.independence: Q2 beat versus $30.2M: https://www.tikr.com/blog/joby-aviation-stock-has-lost-61-this-year-heres-why-barclays-doubts-its-factory-can-keep-up. Q1 call said Blade ramps seasonally into Q3: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/joby-aviation-q1-earnings-call-highlights-2026-05-10/. Caveat: the FY guide of $115-125M implies only $52-62M for H2, so a strong Q3 may simply come at Q4's expense, which is why this is sized small.

findings.finding: Joby delivered the dated Q3 milestones it promised: eIPP flights started in Texas on 9/10 as guided for September, the autonomous cross-country flight came on 9/18, eIPP Florida flights followed on 10/30, and on 11/4 the Air Force expanded its autonomy contracts to nearly $37M with a $50M ceiling on operational testing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose about 7% today on the Air Force release. Defence and autonomy news has moved it intraday before, as with the 3% dip on the $500M Resonant deal in August.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: today's +7% is the market reading it. What remains is the defence narrative the call can extend (Resonant, the Pacific exercises) as a second revenue leg alongside the slow air-taxi path.

findings.finding: Short interest is crowded and rising into the print: 127.28M shares and 5.6 days to cover at the 9/30 settlement, up from 109.8M and 2.43 days on 7/15, and 143.2M / 21.3% of float / 5.8 days on the latest read. Options OI is call-heavy (put/call 0.27), and the stock reacted up after the last four prints (+1.6, +4.2, +21.2, +5.5). A print that merely reaffirms the 2026 targets has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Six of the last eight reactions were up (baseline). The largest, +21.2% in May 2026, came on a reaffirmation plus a revenue beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the thing being priced: the +7.4 put skew says the market pays for downside. The crowded short is the counterweight, because a cover rally needs only an absence of bad news, not good news. Had the short already covered, days to cover would be falling, not up 2.3x since July.
findings.independence: The 9/30 settlement of 127.28M shares and 5.6 days to cover: https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/joby/short-interest/. Equibles shows 108.3M on 8/20. Against this finding: Barclays initiated Underweight with a $4 target on 10/9, which helped build the short.

findings.finding: Insiders sold 1,614,295 shares across 21 transactions in the 90 days to 11/4, all under 10b5-1 plans, including CEO Bevirt at about $6.19 in September and director Sciarra 62,500 shares at about $4.97 on 11/2 (Form 144 filed 11/2, Form 4 filed 11/3). No insider has bought.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Form 144 cluster in early October came during an 11% five-day slide to the 52-week low (trefis, 2026-10-13).
findings.why_not_priced: These sales are public and pre-arranged, so they are largely priced. They carry little information about the print beyond the supply overhang.
findings.independence: EDGAR submissions show the Form 144/4 cluster on 10/2-10/6 and 11/2-11/3: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001819848.json

outside_window.finding: The Resonant Sciences acquisition (about $450-500M, mostly cash) closes in H1/early 2027, subject to approvals.
Toyota's $250M direct investment tranche is expected around year-end 2026 or early 2027.
Joby's post-trial challenge to the $116.9M Aerosonic verdict has no ruling date inside the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: FAA TIA for-credit flight testing by FAA pilots: no Q3/Q4 2026 dated release or report found. The latest are the March 2026 conforming-aircraft first flight and an April 2026 FAA-witnessed flight.
Dubai GCAA aircraft operational approval or a passenger launch date: no RTA, GCAA or Joby release since July 2026.
Archer Aviation Q3 2026 results: not yet reported as of the search, so no read-through.
Q2 2026 call transcript wording on the Dubai date: not found.
Benzinga Q3 preview (2026-11) returned 403, so its content is unavailable.

rejected_candidates.candidate: A source reports an underwritten public offering with about $500.5M net proceeds.
rejected_candidates.detail: No 424B for an underwritten offering appears in EDGAR since 2026-07-15. Only the ATM 424B5 (8/14) and a 424B7 resale (9/11) do. The $500M+ underwritten deal is the October 2025 raise, not a 2026 event.

rejected_candidates.candidate: An ePlane AI headline says 'Joby Aviation Begins Passenger Flights'.
rejected_candidates.detail: The page has no body, and Joby's own releases of 9/10 and 10/30 describe pilot-only eIPP flights with no passenger service.

baseline_tension: The net sign (+0.9) cuts against the +7.4 put skew but agrees with the call-heavy OI and the four-print up streak. The reason for leaning against the skew is a crowded and rising short into a print whose main negative (a 2026 target slip) is already partly discounted by a 68% drawdown. Because that is a positioning argument, not a document, p_up is held at 54.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives): Dubai/targets -1.0 to -0.8, ATM -0.5 to -0.2 (also lesson 4), insider selling -0.2 to -0.1.
Lesson 7 (sign against the skew needs a reason or a smaller size): positioning +1.5 to +1.2; the reason (crowded short, call-heavy OI) is in baseline_tension.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the ATM funds the Resonant cash purchase and runway against $2.3B of cash, not distress, so it stays a small dilution negative.
Lesson 9 / lesson 3: the Blade revenue finding keeps its caveat that the FY guide implies a soft Q4; print_vs_bar cut from +5% to +4%.
Lesson 2: verdict accrual and remeasurement left as small offsetting one-offs; unchanged.
Net: impact_sum 0.6 to 0.9, p_up 53 to 54, abs_move 9.5 unchanged, expected_move 0.57 to 0.76.
